programme.title: Open Range
programme.desc: Boss Spearman (Robert Duvall) and his cowhands Charley (Kevin Costner) and Mose (Abraham Benrubi) are driving cattle across a large expanse of country. When Mose ventures into a sparse village to buy a few necessities, he is met with violent hostility from Denton Baxter (Michael Gambon), an affluent landowner, and his right-hand man, Poole (James Russo). When Mose doesn't come back, Boss and Charley realize he's in trouble, so they plot to get him back and get revenge on those who captured him.

programme.title: The Book of Eli
programme.desc: Thirty years after war turned the world into a wasteland, a lone warrior named Eli marches across the ruined landscape, carrying hope for humanity's redemption. Only one other man understands the power of what Eli carries, and he is determined to take it for himself. Though Eli prefers peace, he must risk death to protect his precious cargo, to fulfill his destiny to help restore mankind.

programme.title: John Wick
programme.desc: Legendary assassin John Wick (Keanu Reeves) retired from his violent career after marrying the love of his life. Her sudden death leaves John in deep mourning. When sadistic mobster Iosef Tarasov (Alfie Allen) and his thugs steal John's prized car and kill the puppy that was a last gift from his wife, John unleashes the remorseless killing machine within and seeks vengeance. Meanwhile, Iosef's father (Michael Nyqvist) -- John's former colleague -- puts a huge bounty on John's head.

programme.title: Unhitched
programme.desc: When writer's block derails the literary dreams of Olly Pickering (Stuart Townsend), he has to move in with his friend Murray (Seth Green) after losing all his money. Things start to look up when Olly's college pal James (Steve John Shepherd) asks him to be the best man at his wedding. Prior to the nuptials, Olly is drawn to a woman whom he thinks is the bride's sister -- only she turns out to be the bride, Sarah (Amy Smart). Can Murray, who dislikes James, help get Sarah and Olly together?

programme.title: Boricua's Bond
programme.desc: Police round up residents of a South Bronx neighborhood and charge them with a crime they did not commit.

programme.title: Lightning Raiders
programme.desc: When his mail doesn't get delivered one day, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is suspicious. He enlists the help of his friend Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) to find out what happened. The duo discovers that the postal stagecoach has been held up by Frank Hayden (Steve Darrell) and his band of thieves, and that the criminals are in hiding. It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains.

programme.title: Outlaws of the Plains
programme.desc: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Prairie Outlaws
programme.desc: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Senorita
programme.desc: Things go from bad to worse for singing cowboy Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and his trusty companion, Teddy Bear (Guinn "Big Boy" Williams), when, after losing their jobs at a local café, the pair are accused of having kidnapped young Chip Williams (Mary Lee) who, in reality, is merely a runaway who's been tagging along with the cowpokes. But amidst these problems, Roy and his partner decide to team up with the girl and her half-sister, Ysobel (Dale Evans), and search for some long-buried treasure.

programme.title: Shotgun
programme.desc: A deputy sheriff (Sterling Hayden) seeks justice with a woman (Yvonne De Carlo), a bounty hunter (Zachary Scott) and a sawed-off shotgun.

programme.title: Canadian Pacific
programme.desc: In the Rocky Mountains, surveyor Tom Andrews (Randolph Scott) tries desperately to find the best route for the Canadian Pacific Railway, with the help of demolitions expert Dynamite Dawson (J. Carrol Naish). A band of trappers opposing the new railroad tries to interfere by sabotaging the construction and inciting the local Native Americans to rebel against the project. Fortunately, Dr. Edith Cabot (Jane Wyatt) is on hand to bind the men's wounds and raise their spirits.

programme.title: Captain Apache
programme.desc: A full-blooded Apache working for the U.S. Army investigates a colleague's murder and uncovers a plot by a wealthy white farmer to instigate an Indian war; gunplay and bloodshed follow as the investigation deepens.

programme.title: Flight of Black Angel
programme.desc: A mentally disturbed Air Force pilot, Capt. Eddie Gordon (William O'Leary), murders his parents and brother, then commandeers a plane that is armed with a nuclear missile. Gordon, who is also a religious zealot, takes to the air and intends to destroy Las Vegas, which he feels deserves to be punished. Gordon's superior officer and squad leader, Col. Matt Ryan (Peter Strauss), goes in pursuit, and hopes to intercept him before he can follow through on his mad scheme.

programme.title: Boyz N the Hood
programme.desc: Tre is sent to live with his father, Furious Styles, in tough South Central Los Angeles. Although his hard-nosed father instills proper values and respect in him, and his devout girlfriend Brandi teaches him about faith, Tre's friends Doughboy and Ricky don't have the same kind of support and are drawn into the neighborhood's booming drug and gang culture, with increasingly tragic results.

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.desc: Can cool Cali boys Jeremy and Michael find love at first date in the Big Apple?

programme.title: Love Is Blind
programme.desc: Can tantric yoga bring these city boys together, or will things be too close for comfort?

programme.title: Love Is Blind
programme.desc: Will Joe's off-beat opinions match up with Jordan's take on the world?

programme.title: Love Is Blind
programme.desc: In the season finale, can Gil and Manny find love during a first date?

programme.title: Queen of New York
programme.desc: Drag Queen Marti Cummings' journey to be the first non-binary candidate elected to New York City Council.

programme.title: Fashion Babylon
programme.desc: Three artists navigate the fashion world as they struggle to thrive in social media culture in a decaying world which is now forced to reinvent itself.

programme.title: The Joneses
programme.desc: Inimitable 73-year-old Jheri Jones appears to be full of self-confidence, but her journey to embrace it has not been so easy. Through family pictures, everyday interactions and candid interviews, a portrait emerges of an unflappable transgender mom triumphing over adversity and transphobia. The Joneses come together to deal with unresolved issues, shattered dreams, seething resentments and redefined realities.

programme.title: Relative
programme.desc: A filmmaker unearths a pervasive history of multigenerational trauma in her Italian-American family. As decades of secrets, home movies, and long-avoided conversations surface, a family once bound by tradition forges a new path forward.

programme.title: Absolutely Fabulous
programme.desc: Edina needs minor surgery, so Patsy tags along for a face lift.

programme.title: Absolutely Fabulous
programme.desc: When Edina's father passes away, Saffy is upset that her mother is more concerned about her weight than his death.

programme.title: Absolutely Fabulous
programme.desc: Edina and Saffy (Jennifer Saunders, Julia Sawalha) tag along when Patsy (Joanna Lumley) has a photo shoot in Morocco.

programme.title: Absolutely Fabulous
programme.desc: After exchanging words, Patsy and Edina (Joanna Lumley, Jennifer Saunders) look for new best friends. Lulu, Britt Ekland and Zandra Rhodes guest star.

programme.title: Absolutely Fabulous
programme.desc: Edina and Patsy (Jennifer Saunders, Joanna Lumley) go to the supermarket for the first time after Saffy (Julia Sawalha) forces her mother to be frugal.

programme.title: Absolutely Fabulous
programme.desc: Edina, Patsy and Saffy (Jennifer Saunders, Joanna Lumley, Julia Sawalha) share their earliest memories while locked in the living room.

programme.title: Metro Sexual
programme.desc: Steph and Langdon struggle to hire a medical student as an explosion of STIs hit Victoria.

programme.title: Metro Sexual
programme.desc: When a bigoted politician visits the clinic, Steph and Yasmin are conflicted about the ethics of treating someone so morally dubious; Langdon helps Greg woo receptionist Gwen in an attempt to stop him catching so many STIs.

programme.title: Metro Sexual
programme.desc: Langdon sets out to find justice when a billboard promoting the clinic is vandalized.

programme.title: Metro Sexual
programme.desc: Steph fears the worst when Amelia Krabb from the health department requests a meeting.

programme.title: I'm Dead
programme.desc: Three comedians find humor in growing up queer.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: In 1941, Nazi soldiers are slaughtering Eastern European Jews by the thousands. Three brothers, Tuvia (Daniel Craig), Zus (Liev Schreiber) and Asael (Jamie Bell), manage to escape and take refuge in the forest where they played in childhood. Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. As news of their exploits spreads, others join the fray, willing to risk their lives for even brief freedom.

programme.title: La Madrina: The Savage Life of Lorine Padilla
programme.desc: Lorine Padilla joins a street gang in the Bronx, N.Y., before becoming an activist and spiritual adviser.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Scientist Karen Ross (Laura Linney) is sent by her father-in-law, mogul R.B. Travis (Joe Don Baker), to the Congo to determine the whereabouts of his son's missing diamond-hunting team. Led by expert guide Kelly (Ernie Hudson), Ross and a mismatched search party -- including primatologist Dr. Peter Elliot (Dylan Walsh), treasure hunter Herkermer Homolka (Tim Curry) and a gorilla -- discover a danger far more sinister than anything they expected to find, even in the heart of the jungle.

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

programme.title: The Bodyguard
programme.desc: Best-selling pop diva Rachel Marron has a stalker whose obsession has risen to the level of disturbing threats. At the urging of her manager, Rachel hires former Secret Service agent Frank Farmer as her bodyguard. Initially resented and treated with disdain for his hard-nosed security procedures, Farmer soon becomes an integral part of Rachel's inner circle. As they spend more time together, client and protector become closer still.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: Flight
programme.desc: Commercial airline pilot Whip Whitaker (Denzel Washington) has a problem with drugs and alcohol, though so far he's managed to complete his flights safely. His luck runs out when a disastrous mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground. Whip pulls off a miraculous crash-landing that results in only six lives lost. Shaken to the core, Whip vows to get sober -- but when the crash investigation exposes his addiction, he finds himself in an even worse situation.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix) takes power and strips rank from Maximus (Russell Crowe), one of the favored generals of his predecessor and father, Emperor Marcus Aurelius, the great stoical philosopher. Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas.

programme.title: Boudica: Queen of War
programme.desc: Roman conquerors slay King Prasutagus, take away his children, and force his wife, Boudica, into subservience. Consumed by grief and a burning desire for justice, Boudica vows to reclaim her homeland from the clutches of the Romans. She soon leads her army in a desperate assault as the fate of her people and her own destiny hang in the balance.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: A carefree lakeside vacation is interrupted by the re-emergence of killer Jason Voorhees (Ted White). After he escapes from a morgue, leaving bodies in his wake, Jason travels to Camp Crystal Lake where a group of friends is staying. The teens meet some locals: Tommy (Corey Feldman) and Trish (Kimberly Beck), as well as secretive hiker Rob (Erich Anderson). As the group of teenagers engages in drunken debauchery, their numbers begin to dwindle, and pieces of the past resurface.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
programme.desc: Mass murderer Jason Voorhees (Kane Hodder) is resurrected from the bottom of Crystal Lake. After he kills a passing boat's occupants, he stows away on a cruise ship filled with a high-school graduating class bound for New York City. Biology teacher Charles McCulloch (Peter Mark Richman) is on board with his niece, Rennie (Jensen Daggett), who has visions of Jason drowning as a child. They escape his bloody shipboard rampage, but, when Rennie and Charles reach Manhattan, Jason is close by.

programme.title: Kindred
programme.desc: A pair of twisted, young criminals decide to break into a mansion for one big score, but they soon find out that the owners of the house are much more dangerous than they are.

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed.

programme.title: Guns Up
programme.desc: After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: Agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) becomes acting deputy director of the CIA when Admiral Greer (James Earl Jones) is diagnosed with cancer. When an American businessman, and friend of the president, is murdered on a yacht, Ryan starts discovering links between the man and drug dealers. As CIA agent John Clark (Willem Dafoe) is sent to Colombia to kill drug kingpins in retaliation, Ryan must fight through multiple cover-ups to figure out what happened and who's responsible.

programme.title: Baby Driver
programme.desc: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system.

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Literature professor Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) leads a secret life as a high-stakes gambler. Always a risk-taker, Bennett bets it all when he borrows from a gangster and offers his own life as collateral. Staying one step ahead, he pits his creditor against the operator of an illicit gambling ring while garnering the attention of Frank (John Goodman), a paternalistic loan shark. As his relationship with a student (Brie Larson) deepens, Bennett must risk everything for a second chance.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education.

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980 Texas, a college freshman meets his new baseball teammates, an unruly group of disco-dancing, skirt-chasing partiers.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: The Lovely Bones
programme.desc: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression.

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly.

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: Ecstatic when his parents leave on vacation for a few days, high school senior Joel Goodsen cuts loose with his best friend Miles. After an attempt at securing the services of a prostitute goes slightly awry, Joel hires gorgeous Lana for a night of delight. Stunned by the amount of Lana's "bill" the next morning, Joel grows frantic after he crashes his father's Porsche. In an effort to raise lots of money fast, a desperate Joel turns the house into a brothel.

programme.title: Peep World
programme.desc: Revelations arise when members (Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman) of a dysfunctional Jewish family gather to celebrate the patriarch's (Ron Rifkin) 70th birthday.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody...

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s).

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: A transplanted New Yorker attempting to acclimate to Los Angeles, Mike Peters (Jon Favreau), is struggling to both boost his comedy career and get over his last relationship. A self-proclaimed master of seduction, Mike's buddy, Trent Walker (Vince Vaughn), tries to show him how to make connections and get the attention of women. Slowly moving toward regaining his confidence, Mike meets the gorgeous and down-to-earth Lorraine (Heather Graham), sparking a welcome new romance.

programme.title: The Hangover Part II
programme.desc: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, prewedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen.

programme.title: The Hangover Part III
programme.desc: It's been two years since the gang known as the Wolfpack narrowly escaped disaster in Bangkok. Now, Phil (Bradley Cooper), Stu (Ed Helms) and Doug (Justin Bartha) have happy lives at home -- but Alan (Zach Galifianakis) doesn't. Still lacking contentment and a sense of purpose, Alan has gone off his meds and surrendered to his natural impulses. It's up to the other members of the Wolfpack to get him through his personal crisis by embarking on a road trip to the place it all began: Las Vegas.

programme.title: Clerks
programme.desc: Dante (Brian O'Halloran) is called in to cover a shift at his New Jersey convenience store on his day off. His friend Randal (Jeff Anderson) helps him pass the time, neglecting his video-store customers next door to hang out in the Quick Stop. The uneventful day is disrupted by news that one of Dante's ex-girlfriends has died. After attending her memorial service, Dante muses over staying with current girlfriend Veronica (Marilyn Ghigliotti) or reuniting with ex Caitlin (Lisa Spoonhauer).

programme.title: Nightwatch
programme.desc: Law student Martin Bells (Ewan McGregor) needs to make some money, and so he takes a side job as a night watchman in a morgue. He thinks he'll have time to study, but with a serial killer on the loose -- one with a propensity for necrophilia -- he has to be more alert than ever. While at work, Martin starts putting together the clues and realizes that the police, including Inspector Thomas Cray (Nick Nolte), have good reason to make him their prime suspect.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: In the 25th century, the Earth's population has dwindled to a surviving five million following a devastating virus that almost resulted in the extinction of all human life 400 years earlier. Confined to one city-state, a group of rebels, led by Handler (Frances McDormand), seeks to destroy the oppressive government -- first, by assassinating a high-ranking chairman (Marton Csokas). Tasked with this mission, Aeon Flux (Charlize Theron) must integrate herself in a world of deceit and mystery.

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: Career thief Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) is about to mastermind a nearly impossible theft that will require his joining forces with a clever young accomplice (Edward Norton). The unlikely alliance, arranged by Nick's longtime friend and fence, Max (Marlon Brando), interrupts Nick's plan to retire from crime and settle down with his fiancée, Diane (Angela Bassett). Worse, it requires that Nick violate his most important rule: Always work alone.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: Years ago, Tommy Jarvis (Thom Mathews) killed infamous hockey-masked murderer Jason Voorhees (C.J. Graham), and the intensity of the experience has landed him in a mental institution. To end his torment and achieve a level of closure, Tommy escapes from the hospital and heads to the graveyard where Jason is buried, intending to dig up the body and cremate it. But, before this total annihilation can occur, a freak electrical accident resurrects Jason from the dead, and the terror begins anew.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-head Do America
programme.desc: Two of the biggest animated slackers around, Beavis (Mike Judge) and Butt-head (also Judge) get a kick-start when two crooks steal their TV. On their mission to find a replacement, Beavis and Butt-head wind up in the motel of Muddy Grimes (Bruce Willis), where a case of mistaken identity has them after his wife, Dallas (Demi Moore). Due to misunderstanding Grimes when he says to "do" his wife, the two travel from Las Vegas to Washington, not realizing they've been sent out to kill the woman.

programme.title: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: After their friend Billy (Anthony Starr) dies, Tom (Dax Shepard), Jerry (Matthew Lillard) and Dan (Seth Green) go on a camping trip to honor his memory. The campsite, however, has special significance. Billy believed famous airplane hijacker D.B. Cooper hid money in the area, and his friends aim to find it. Unfortunately, they are not prepared for the adventure. After falling over a waterfall, they are left to the mercy of wild animals and a harsh wilderness terrain.

programme.title: Without a Paddle: Nature's Calling
programme.desc: Two friends (Oliver James, Kristopher Turner) and a crazy Briton (Rik Young) have wild misadventures while searching for a missing girl in the woods.

programme.title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
programme.desc: When Jay and Silent Bob learn that a Bluntman and Chronic movie is being made featuring their comic book counterparts, they drool at the thought of fat movie checks rolling in. But when the pair find that there won't be any royalties coming their way, they set out to sabotage the flick at all costs.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: Commodus (Joaquin Phoenix) takes power and strips rank from Maximus (Russell Crowe), one of the favored generals of his predecessor and father, Emperor Marcus Aurelius, the great stoical philosopher. Maximus is then relegated to fighting to the death in the gladiator arenas.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Officer K (Ryan Gosling), a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford), a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue.

programme.title: Rumours
programme.desc: Leaders of the world's wealthiest democracies gather for the annual G7 summit to draft a provisional statement regarding a global crisis. They soon become spectacles of incompetence, contending with increasingly surreal obstacles as night falls in the misty woods and they realize they are suddenly alone.

programme.title: What Women Want
programme.desc: Nick Marshall (Mel Gibson) gets a whole new outlook on life when a fluke accident gives him the ability to read women's minds. At first, this "gift" provides Nick with way too much information, but he begins to realize that he can use it to good effect, especially when it comes to outwitting his new boss, Darcy Maguire (Helen Hunt).

programme.title: Waking Up in Reno
programme.desc: Candy (Charlize Theron) and Lonnie Earl (Billy Bob Thornton) are just crazy about each other. The problem: she's married to Roy (Patrick Swayze) and he's married to Darlene (Natasha Richardson). So far it's been a secret affair. But that's about to change, because this foursome is driving cross-country and headed for some big surprises.

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline.

programme.title: Last Weekend
programme.desc: Petty squabbling marks the Memorial Day reunion of an affluent matriarch (Patricia Clarkson) and her dysfunctional family (Chris Mulkey, Zachary Booth).

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: Baltimore-based friends and lovers, all in their 20s and 30s, try to navigate their way through the complexities of modern relationships. Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna.

programme.title: Zumbo's Just Desserts
programme.desc: Following a chocolate-themed challenge, two contestants face a Zumbo Test involving 100 handmade profiteroles.

programme.title: Hot Mess Express
programme.desc: Hot Mess Patrick visits the So Yummy kitchen and attempts to cook a real meal; Patrick receives verbal assistance from Chef Lola to cook a restaurant-level dish.

programme.title: Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Today's brand new Come Dine With Me Professionals heads to South Wales, where Prego start the week with sibling duo Toni and Andrea aiming to provide a fully authentic Italian experience for their guests.

programme.title: Sugar Showdown
programme.desc: Three contestants compete in an elimination round with Chinese five spice as the mystery ingredient; the last two standing compete for the top prize in a Chinese New Year-themed pie showdown.

programme.title: Sugar Showdown
programme.desc: A speedy elimination round with pink peppercorns as the mystery ingredient; Elizabeth Chambers, Duff Goldman and Elise Strachan decide which remaining finalists will take home the prize in a special hide-and-seek-themed cupcake showdown.

programme.title: Wall of Chefs
programme.desc: An unorthodox pairing of mole and scallops has the Wall paying attention in the Crowd-Pleaser round; the home cooks don't know which way the feta will crumble with Chef Christine Cushing's challenge.

programme.title: Project Bakeover
programme.desc: Little Cove Bakery in the tourist town of Tobermory is languishing in the off-season; owner Kelly has used up all her savings and will have to shut down if Steve can't turn her business around fast.

programme.title: Wall of Bakers
programme.desc: A savory crowd-pleaser makes a splash in the first round, and the maple sugar in Chef Patrice Demers' pantry has the home bakers saying ooh Canada; the final two home bakers take a layered approach to bringing home the title and 10,000 dollars.

programme.title: Zumbo's Just Desserts
programme.desc: Adriano Zumbo puts 12 amateur dessert makers to the test; contestants must make a dessert that best reflects them.

programme.title: Zumbo's Just Desserts
programme.desc: The amateur cooks are tasked with bringing a "Franken-Zumbo" to life.

programme.title: Zumbo's Just Desserts
programme.desc: Following a chocolate-themed challenge, two contestants face a Zumbo Test involving 100 handmade profiteroles.

programme.title: Hot Mess Express
programme.desc: Hot Mess Patrick visits the So Yummy kitchen and attempts to cook a real meal; Patrick receives verbal assistance from Chef Lola to cook a restaurant-level dish.

programme.title: Flat Out Food

programme.title: CFP Semifinal at the VRBO Fiesta Bowl
programme.desc: Miami vs. Ole Miss No. 6 Ole Miss faces No. 10 Miami in the Fiesta Bowl at State Farm Stadium for a spot in the College Football Playoff semifinals. The Rebels seek an eighth straight win behind Kewan Lacy (23 TDs), while the Hurricanes lean on QB Carson Beck (27 TDs).

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Clemson at Georgia Tech The No. 12 Tigers seek a 10th straight win over the Yellow Jackets in this match from Bobby Dodd Stadium. Clemson doubled up Georgia Tech 42-21 behind four TD passes from Cade Klubnik on Nov. 11, 2023. Georgia Tech leads the all-time series 51-36-2.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: North Carolina at Syracuse The Orange host the Tar Heels for some Friday night frights at the JMA Wireless Dome. Both teams have been spooked of late, losing four in a row. North Carolina has haunted Syracuse across the past two meetings, outscoring the Orange 71-13.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Clemson at Georgia Tech The No. 12 Tigers seek a 10th straight win over the Yellow Jackets in this match from Bobby Dodd Stadium. Clemson doubled up Georgia Tech 42-21 behind four TD passes from Cade Klubnik on Nov. 11, 2023. Georgia Tech leads the all-time series 51-36-2.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Duke at Clemson The Tigers (3-4, 2-3 ACC) and Blue Devils (4-3, 3-1) return from the bye. In 2023, Duke snapped a five-game series slide with its first victory over Clemson since 2004. Duke's three-game win streak was snapped by undefeated Georgia Tech on Oct. 18.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: TaxSlayer Gator Bowl: Virginia vs. Missouri The No. 19 Cavaliers try to bounce back against the Tigers in the Gator Bowl. programme.title: That's So Raven
programme.desc: S01 E12 — Teach Your Children Well Raven's mom take a temporary teaching job at her school and does so well she's offered a permanent position; Raven is horrified.

programme.title: That's So Raven

programme.title: That's So Raven

programme.title: That's So Raven
programme.desc: S01 E15 — Saturday Afternoon Fever Raven tries to get out of spending "quality time" with her mom so she can go to a movie with a cute boy instead.

programme.title: That's So Raven

programme.title: That's So Raven
programme.desc: S01 E17 — Psychics Wanted Raven has a vision of a boy asking her out and does everything she can to make it happen; her job at the psychic phone line complicates things.

programme.title: That's So Raven
programme.desc: S01 E18 — If I Only Had a Job Raven has a vision of her dad getting fired from his job and tries to prevent it but only makes things worse.

programme.title: That's So Raven
programme.desc: S02 E04 — Escape Claus A teacher, who has the day off to play Santa at the mall, catches Raven, Chelsea and Eddie skipping school.

programme.title: That's So Raven
programme.desc: S02 E05 — Separation Anxiety Raven has a vision of her parents separating; she tries to stop it by recreating their first date but misses the mark.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: S01 E29 — Fun Uncle Pat; Kiff Escape! Kiff's favorite uncle visits; Kiff and the crew solve an escape room.

programme.title: Kiff

programme.title: Kiff

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: S02 E02 — The Other Movie; Roy-alty Check Kiff, Barry, and Trevor sneak into a movie and try not to get caught. Martin and Beryl vie for Kiff's favor when Kiff comes into some money.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: S02 E03 — Stramded; Hairstory Kiff and the gang get trapped in the aerial tram and try not to lose their minds; Kiff gets a haircut she hates.

programme.title: Kiff

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: S02 E05 — Taily; Cocina Island Kiff runs for class president against a surprise candidate, Mr. RiPeppa. The Chatterleys take Barry on their island vacation, but he seems to have a dark secret.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: S02 E06 — Up All Night; Rotten Banana Kiff and Barry try to stay awake until 4am to see a very special comet. Kiff meets a bad banana.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Pokemon -- I Choose You! Ash Ketchum, a 10-year-old from Pallet Town, is finally old enough to receive his first Pokémon; however, he oversleeps and the only remaining Pokémon at Professor Oak's lab is a strong-willed Pikachu!

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Pokémon Emergency Ash, carrying his badly wounded Pikachu, rushes into Viridian City, which is on alert for Pokémon thieves like Jessie, James and Meowth of Team Rocket; Ash tries in vain to fight off Team Rocket's Pokémon, but his Pikachu and others join the fray.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Ash Catches a Pokémon Ash captures his first Pokémon, a Caterpie; Ash battles for and wins a Pidgeotto; Ash's Caterpie surprises everybody in his first battle against Team Rocket.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Challenge of the Samurai A young samurai challenges Ash to a battle; a swarm of angry Beedrill interrupt the battle causing Ash to flee and leave Metapod behind.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Showdown in Pewter City While in Pewter City, Ash challenges Brock to a battle; Team Rocket falls into a trap they built themselves.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Clefairy and the Moon Stone A scientist leads Ash and his friends deep into Mount Moon to find the storied Moon Stone, which is said to increase the power of Pokémon.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E07 — The Waterflowers of Cerulean City Ash seeks to win trainer badges in Cerulean City by confronting the gym leaders; Misty doesn't want to join the Ash on this journey.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E08 — The Path to the Pokémon League Ash wins his second badge and learns of a fierce trainer, A.J., who has never lost a match; Ash prepares to challenge A.J.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E09 — The School of Hard Knocks Ash discovers a school for Pokémon trainers that bullies the kids to make the stronger; Misty challenges the ringleader, Giselle, to a battle.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E10 — Bulbasaur and the Hidden Village The gang finds themselves in a town where Melanie takes care of injured or abandoned Pokémon; Ash earns a battle with Melanie.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E11 — Charmander: The Stray Pokémon Ash, Misty and Brock come across an injured Charmander on their way to Vermilion City; Ash tries to catch it, but it turns out it has a trainer and can't be captured, so they head to the Pokémon Center.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E12 — Here Comes the Squirtle Squad Ash, Misty and Brock become the victims of the Squirtle Squad's pranks; the Squirtle lets Pikachu get medicine from town after being injured.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E13 — Mystery at the Lighthouse The party meets Bill, a Pokémon researcher who is waiting in his lighthouse for the coming of a one-of-a-kind Pokémon, never before seen by humans; could such a Pokémon truly exist?

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E14 — Electric Shock Showdown Eager to earn a badge, Ash challenges Lt. Surge; Pikachu reluctantly enters the battle, only to discover that its opponent is a Raichu, a fierce Pokémon with tremendous electric power and the evolved form of Pikachu!

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E15 — Battle Aboard the St. Anne Ash and his friends board a ship called the St. Anne, but the ship's employees reveal themselves to be members of Team Rocket.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E16 — Pokémon Shipwreck A powerful storm forces everyone except Team Rocket and the heroes to abandon the sinking St. Anne; Ash, Brock and Misty are forced to team up with their long-standing enemies in order to survive this sticky situation!

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E17 — Island of the Giant Pokémon The heroes and Team Rocket beat the odds by surviving the sinking of the St. Anne; they are dragged into another perilous situation when they are attacked by Gyarados!

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E19 — Tentacool & Tentacruel Team Rocket attempts to get rid of the Tentacool at Porta Vista, but their plan backfires; the Tentacool are transformed into giant Tentacruel and attack Porta Vista.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E20 — The Ghost of Maiden's Peak Ash, Misty and Brock arrive in the port city of Maiden's Peak and join in the summer festival; Brock and James may be part of the legend of Maiden Park.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E21 — Bye, Bye Butterfree On a cliff over the ocean, the gang discover a flock of Butterfree searching for mates; Ash's Butterfree joins the flock but is rejected.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E22 — Abra and the Psychic Showdown The gang finally arrives in Saffron City; a young girl, Sabrina, commands a Pokémon Gym with her psychic powers; Ash challenges Sabrina to a battle for the Marsh Badge.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E23 — The Tower of Terror Ash is on the search for a ghost-type Pokémon to try to defeat Sabrina; the gang heads to the Pokémon Tower in Lavender Town, where they are said to live.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E24 — Haunter vs. Kadabra Leaving Pokémon Tower with Haunter in tow, Ash returns to Saffron City with only one goal in mind; he looks to win a Gym Badge from the powerful Sabrina!

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E25 — Primeape Goes Bananas When Ash tries to catch a wild Mankey, it loses its cool and uses Thrash on the whole gang; Team Rocket makes matters worse when it arrives.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E26 — Pokémon Scent-sation! Ash is denied entry into the Gym for criticizing a perfume which is made there; Ash goes to outrageous lengths to win entry into the Gym.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E27 — Hypno's Naptime Ash and the team help Officer Jenny search for missing children; Nurse Joy's patients are not getting well; a mysterious Sleep Wave has been hitting the town.

programme.title: Pokémon the Series: Indigo League
programme.desc: S01 E28 — Pokémon Fashion Flash Brock would like to be Susie's trainee in her Pokémon beauty salon; a new salon opens up on Scissor Street, and is hassling the long-term shop owners.

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Rumors Lizzie accidentally starts a rumor about Kate; trouble ensues.

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire
programme.desc: S01 E03 — When Moms Attack Lizzie (Hilary Duff) looks forward to a field trip until she finds out that her mother is one of the chaperons.

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire
programme.desc: S01 E08 — Misadventures of Babysitting Chaos erupts when Lizzie (Hilary Duff) baby-sits her little brother Matt (Jake Thomas) with the help of pals Gordo and Miranda (Adam Lamberg, Lalaine).

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire
programme.desc: S01 E09 — Election Lizzie (Hilary Duff) runs for class president; Matt (Jake Thomas) hoodwinks his parents into buying him presents.

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire
programme.desc: S01 E10 — I Do, I Don't Lizzie (Hilary Duff) "marries" Gordo (Adam Lamberg) in social studies class but covets Miranda's (Lalaine) handsome husband.

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire
programme.desc: S01 E11 — Bad Girl McGuire Lizzie (Hilary Duff) and her new friend, Angel, embark on a life of crime; Matt (Jake Thomas) insists on staying up late.

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire
programme.desc: S01 E12 — Between a Rock and a Bra Place Lizzie and Miranda go shopping for bras with Lizzie's mother; actor David Carradine gives Matt a helping hand.

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire
programme.desc: S01 E13 — Come Fly With Me Gordo (Adam Lamberg) tries to live up to his reputation as a lounge-era Lothario by renouncing his sweetheart. With Hilary Duff.

programme.title: Lizzie McGuire
programme.desc: S01 E14 — Random Acts of Miranda Lizzie reports on the school play Miranda is in; Matt sells his possessions for money to buy walkie-talkies.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: VENDPOCALYPSE THE MUSICAL Doof starts the vendpocalypse; Doof saves Norm.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: Elevator Irritator; Master of Fate Candace and the boys are stuck in an elevator next to Doof and Agent P; the kids are visited by the Master of Fate while Agent P has his OWCA performance review.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E01 — Summer Block Buster; Cloudy with a Chance of Mom The boys decide to ramp up their local summer block party with supersized attractions; the kids work to save Mom after she is hit by Doof's inator.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E02 — Submarine Sandwich Submarine; License to Bust The kids build a giant submarine sandwich submarine while Doof steals food; Candace tries to bust the boys while taking her driving test; Doof causes chaos in traffic.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E03 — Dry Another Day; Deconstructing Doof The boys build an endless ice luge to beat the heat while Doof brings oil to a water park; Candace and Doof see the same psychologist, who thinks their experiences may be connected.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E04 — Tropey McTropeface; Biblio-Blast! The boys build a zoetrope that goes on an adventure of its own; the kids build a bookcase that gets attacked by an army of Doof-plants.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E05 — A Chip to the Vet; More Than an Intern The boys bring Perry to the vet for a checkup and build a pet wash while they wait; Carl tries to help Perry stop Doof while working three other part-time jobs.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E06 — The Aurora Perry-Alis; Lord of the Firesides The Flynn-Fletchers take a cruise; Doof steals shrunken goods; Isabella struggles to lead the Fireside Girls on her own, while Doof renews his evil business license.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E07 — The Candace Suit; Agent T (for Teen) Candace puts Mom in a Candace costume in hopes that she'll finally see the boys' invention; Stacy takes on an agent role with OWCA to rescue Perry from some evil scientists.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E08 — The Haberdasher; Out of Character Doof becomes a Mothman; the boys make a movie set.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E09 — The Chronicles of Meap: Meap Me in St. Louis Meap enlists Candace and the kids to help bust his nemesis, Mitch, before he can steal a long-lost treasure hidden somewhere on Earth.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E10 — No Slumber Party; The Ballad of Bubba Doof The kids have a sleepover; Doof's cousin traps Perry.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E11 — Attack of the Candace Suit; Book Flub Buford's Candace suit comes to life and tries to take over the real Candace's life; Candace ignores her brothers for a day in order to help her Mom with a bust of her own.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E12 — The Bad Old Days; Mantis Fact Vanessa and Doof travel to Drusselstein while the boys dig for Mom's lost wedding ring; the kids build a bird mansion for a rare macaw while Doof deals with giant praying mantises.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E13 — The Nightmare-Inator; Doof in Retrograde Doof's dream-project-inator misfires and projects people's dreams for all to see; Doof becomes the center of his own solar system while Irving tries to impress Phineas and Ferb.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: S05 E14 — Bend It Like Doof; Dooflicated OWCA and LOVEMUFFIN face off in a soccer match while the boys help Buford with his aim; people around Danville turn evil after being hit by Doof's latest inator.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part One: 1869-1932 In the aftermath of the Civil War, America's South is looking to put the past behind it, and finds one path in a growing cultural passion of the North - football. In December 1932, the Southeastern Conference is officially formed.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Two: 1933-1959 Multiple SEC schools claim national titles from the 1930s through the '50s, including LSU with star running back Billy Cannon in 1958, prior to Cannon's epic game-winning punt return against powerhouse Ole Miss a year later.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Three: 1960-1970 In the 1960s, as Georgia Tech leaves the conference and the Civil Rights Movement becomes embedded in the history and image of the region, Bear Bryant, hired in 1958, becomes the face of Alabama - and SEC football.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Four: 1969-1979 As a new decade dawns, quarterbacks Archie Manning, Bert Jones and Condredge Holloway build memorable legacies. Bear Bryant begins a new run of dominance at Alabama, and the rise of television sports transforms the SEC.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Five: 1980-1989 The 1980s begin with Herschel Walker leading Georgia to a national title as a freshman. After Bear Bryant retires in 1982 and passes away four weeks later, control of the SEC is eventually transferred to Pat Dye and Bo Jackson at Auburn.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Six: 1990-1999 The 1990s bring change, with expansion and the sport's first-ever conference championship game. Florida's Steve Spurrier fashions an era of high-octane offense, and his Gators form a rivalry with Tennessee and QB Peyton Manning.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part Seven: 2000-2009 Nick Saban comes to LSU in 2000 and eventually wins the Tigers' first national championship since 1958 - a feat matched by Les Miles. At Florida, Tim Tebow becomes a cult hero and wins two national titles with Urban Meyer's Gators.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football
programme.desc: Part 8: SEC, SEC, SEC! The SEC has a run of seven straight national titles, and nine in 12 years. Expansion in 2012 gives the conference 14 schools. Meanwhile, Nick Saban arguably becomes the greatest coach in the history of college football.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part One (1930-1959) Adolph Rupp comes to the University of Kentucky in 1930, two years before the SEC is formed, and his Wildcats go on to dominate play in the conference for decades. Meanwhile, a future coaching legend later known as Pat Summitt is born in Tennessee.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Two (1960-1970) Texas Western's historic win over Adolph Rupp's Kentucky team in the 1966 NCAA final marks a turning point in the SEC. Vanderbilt's Perry Wallace becomes the conference's first Black player, while at LSU, Pete Maravich rewrites the record books.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Three (1971-1979) Dale Brown brings an infectious personality to LSU while Pat Summitt begins her legendary coaching career at Tennessee. And the year after Adolph Rupp's death in 1977, his successor Joe B. Hall leads Kentucky to its first NCAA title in 20 years.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Four (1980-1989) Georgia's Dominique Wilkins and Auburn's Charles Barkley headline the SEC's successes in the early 1980s, while LSU's Dale Brown takes two teams to the Final Four. Pat Summitt wins her first two national titles at Tennessee.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Five (1990-1998) Arkansas joins the SEC and becomes one of the conference's top teams, led by fiery coach Nolan Richardson and his "40 Minutes of Hell" attack. Kentucky returns to prominence, and at Tennessee, Pat Summitt wins three straight NCAA titles.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball
programme.desc: Part Six (1998-2010) In his first year at Kentucky, Tubby Smith becomes the third Black coach ever to win a national title. Florida's back-to-back NCAA crowns mark the rise of a new power. The Lady Vols win 2 straight NCAA titles as LSU reaches 5 straight Final Fours.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E01 — The Nectar of the Mayan Gods Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E02 — Guayabera World In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E03 — The Best Tacos In Mérida Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E04 — An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E05 — The Art of the Egg Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E06 — Yucatán Meats Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E07 — The Famous Pastes of Spices Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E08 — Mayan Gateway To The Underworld No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E09 — Yucatán's Most Unique Salts An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E10 — A Mayan League of their Own In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.desc: S12 E05 — The Art of the Egg Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E06 — Yucatán Meats Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E04 — Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S02 E01 — Whole Hog BBQ with Pitmaster Pat Martin Jess teams up with legendary West Tennessee pitmaster and whole hog expert Pat Martin to cook a hog overnight and enjoy a special cut of beef from Australia.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S02 E05 — Texas A&M Meat Science Experiment In windy Canyon, Texas, Jess visits West Texas A&M, where she interacts with a cloned cow, participates in a blind meat tasting experiment, and helps teach us how to break down a carcass into the cuts we see in the grocery store.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Northstar Bison Smash Burger Jess visits Northstar Bison to learn about the small family-run ranch's breeding and processing operation, then prepares her signature smash burger.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E01 — Alpine Lamb Ribs from Siddoway Sheep Company Jess joins the lamb-raising Siddoway family as they begin sorting the animals that are ready for processing. She then returns to the lodge, where she demonstrates how to prepare and grill lamb ribs.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S02 E02 — Benton's Famous Tennessee Hams Jess loves country hams and there's no better place to visit than Benton's--a family-run business that's been perfecting curing and aging techniques for over 50 years.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S02 E03 — Braving Wisconsin's Cannibal Sandwich Jess embarks on a road trip across Wisconsin with her good friend Kaitlin, stopping for a cannibal sandwich and a famous sausage from Usinger's in Milwaukee.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E10 — Texas Tomahawk from Wyatt Ranches Jess heads to Wyatt Ranches in South Texas to check out the cattle ranching operation they've been running since 1965.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E06 — Nashville Hot Dove Sliders at Redstone Ranch Jess and her husband Chris head to their favorite hunting grounds, Redstone Ranch, situated in the heart of the migratory dove flyway.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S01 E07 — Oklahoma's Wild Hog Sausage Roll Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeño and cheddar.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore
programme.desc: S02 E06 — Backyard Cabrito Asado in Texas Jess joins her friend Javi in his backyard, where he welds custom cooking contraptions, including an asado cross they use to cook cabrito together.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Turkey Tenders and Salmon Chef Andrew Zimmern shares his favorite way to prepare wild turkey breast, pan-fried over an open fire. Served with cheese sauce and jalapeno-bacon wild rice. Then, cooks a simple meal of seared salmon and a side of crispy potatoes and onions.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.desc: S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.desc: S01 E03 — Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.desc: S02 E03 — Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.desc: S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.desc: S01 E05 — The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
programme.desc: S01 E02 — The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.
